name: Bandar Lampung
registryBasis: The official city ATR/BPN portal identifies the local land office, and the national public-service listing records a local map (“Peta”) service product. The city’s own JIGN Geoportal is described as exposing GIS web services, but its anonymous homepage request returned HTTP 502. The ATR/BPN root is a JavaScript shell; no anonymous parcel geometry contract was exposed by inspected HTML or static bundles.
pointBasis: UN WUP 2025 population-weighted settlement centroid; this is not a municipal boundary or a parcel-coverage claim.
technicalBlocker: The city JIGN Geoportal homepage returned HTTP 502, so no service catalog or schema could be fetched. The official city ATR/BPN app returned a JavaScript shell; its two public static bundles expose no map or cadastral feature route. Public city data API searches for “persil” and “pertanahan” returned zero records; “tanah” returned two unrelated non-spatial datasets. No anonymous parcel geometry route was verified.
scopeLimits: Review covered Bandar Lampung’s local ATR/BPN application shell, its municipal JIGN Geoportal route, and city open-data search metadata. No city parcel polygons or schema were verified.
remainingUncertainty: A separate local land-office mapping route or service may exist, but the current public Geoportal request failed and the ATR/BPN frontend client did not expose an anonymous vector geometry contract.
